source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
During [Declare Battle Formations](vsdata:core-rule/chapter-approved.declare-battle-formations), you can place your **ASURYANI MOUNTED** and **VYPER** units into Reserves. In the battle, they can arrive on the battlefield as though from [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves). Whenever you set up one of your **ASURYANI MOUNTED** or **VYPER** units on the battlefield, count the battle round number as 1 higher than it is.

As your opponent's turn ends, you can also take some of your **ASURYANI MOUNTED** or **VYPER** units off the battlefield and into Strategic Reserves, other than units in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy unit. How many depends on [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size): up to 1 in Incursion, 2 in Strike Force or 3 in Onslaught.

battleRoundForSetup.appliesTo: every setup of a friendly ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit on the battlefield
